change.heading: Notes about this release
paragraphs: The v2 standards pack explains the governed method and its reproducibility records through bounded synthetic verification. It pairs TR010, an implementation report and reference protocol, with TR010-R, the results and limitations report. It does not reproduce the full v1.0 enterprise lifecycle. [E01, E04, E08, E26]

The planned v3 enterprise release is intended to build on the v1.0 three-path foundation and the v2 authorization and package-integrity controls. Its objective is full-scale end-to-end reproduction within a defined enterprise scope, supported by the necessary datasets, configurations and execution evidence. V3 is not yet released; this objective is not a verified v2 result or an approved release.
change.markdown_after:
**Notes about this release**

The v2 standards pack explains the governed method and its reproducibility records through bounded synthetic verification. It pairs TR010, an implementation report and reference protocol, with TR010-R, the results and limitations report. It does not reproduce the full v1.0 enterprise lifecycle. [E01, E04, E08, E26]

The planned v3 enterprise release is intended to build on the v1.0 three-path foundation and the v2 authorization and package-integrity controls. Its objective is full-scale end-to-end reproduction within a defined enterprise scope, supported by the necessary datasets, configurations and execution evidence. V3 is not yet released; this objective is not a verified v2 result or an approved release.
